name: False alarm: the printer's paper settles
notes: N1110 (pace). Played by FS47Calm, at SARO indoors. A small shuffle from the printer, a soft thump, then nothing. Ordinary: the paper in the tray settling. Silence first, then the ordinary reveal. No finding, no danger, no camera.

beats.text: The printer. The paper in the tray settled, that's all.
